audit.description: Changed production code removes the direct `import requests` from `chessdotcom/client.py` and imports real `urllib3` instead. The new `_RequestsAdapter.get` constructs `urllib3.PoolManager` or `urllib3.ProxyManager` and calls `http.request("GET", ...)`, while static and dynamic evidence show no source-library imports from production repo code. The only observed `requests` import is from an external dependency (`vcr/patch.py`), and target resolution points to site-packages `urllib3` with no local target provider.

reasons: Production code meaningfully uses urllib3 PoolManager/ProxyManager for HTTP requests.
Static anti-cheat reports chessdotcom/client.py imports target and does not import source.
Dynamic anti-cheat reports zero source imports from production repo and target events from chessdotcom/client.py.
No local fake urllib3 provider or sys.modules alias evidence was reported.
